title: tuned_guest_host_size
question: Is the tuned guest (1 vCPU / 1 GiB, no omnibox preload, a quiet console, huge pages) cheaper per task on a 4-vCPU or a 16-vCPU c8i host?
answer: The 4-vCPU host is cheaper: c8i.xlarge held 6–7 microVMs at $0.019–0.027 per 1,000 tasks, c8i.4xlarge 25–28 at $0.025–0.030. Host CPU ran out first on both.

why.m8i-4xlarge-lean: Standing control, lean: guest-cold-1's spec, unchanged, so it pools.
